def entrance_block_exact(A: Poly, B: Poly) -> ExactEntranceBlock: """凸 A、B（CCW）的 E = B ⊕ (−A)，精确。A、B 须**精确**凸（`is_convex_exact`），否则 ValueError—— 凹块（含刚体运动后舍入成微凹的平直顶点）不能走凸路径。""" for name, P in (("A", A), ("B", B)): why = convexity_violation(P) if why is not None: > raise ValueError(f"input polygon {name} is not exactly convex: {why} " f"(a flat vertex rounded by a rigid motion may be reflex; use the concave path)") E ValueError: input polygon A is not exactly convex: reflex vertex 1 (a flat vertex rounded by a rigid motion may be reflex; use the concave path)
